category_title: Older preschool children expressing specific anxieties about environmental and relational consistency
scenario_title: Anxiety about relational consistency while observing moving trucks
minimal_context: The student is participating in a group conversation outdoors near the fence while watching moving trucks arrive to move a neighboring building.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Look at the moving trucks arriving to move the building next door.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Will the new school have a backyard?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We can talk about the new building later.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: But is my teacher going to be there?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's just stand by the fence and watch the trucks for now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Will we have the same teachers? And will there be a park? What toys will be brought to the new school?
